node.statement: For every n and X in M_n tensor S^A_{P,Q}, amplified almost-containment gives Co^A_{R_n}(X)=X+O(t)||X||; expanding F^R_{P,Q}=Co^{A_R}_{P^R,Q^R}, replacing its two internal products by ambient products, and replacing P^R,Q^R,Co_R X by P,Q,X gives ||F^R_{P,Q}(Co^A_R X)-X|| <= C_fwd*t*||X|| with a universal coefficient independent of n.
